moments.action: In a dim Tokyo alley the young man in the white thermal and the grey-haired man in the olive jacket talk in tight close-ups; the shot then opens to a wide that shows them squared up a pace apart.

moments.action: Close-ups trade back and forth: the older man leans in to press his point hard, and the younger man's face shifts from listening to a flat, closed-off stare by the end of the exchange.

moments.action: Left alone in frame, the older man turns to watch. Past his shoulder the young man is already walking away down the dark street, not looking back.

moments.action: A wide shot finds the young man alone against a pillar in an empty night garage. He looks up as the friend in the mint-green shirt walks in past a green car, ending his wait.

moments.action: Face to face by the car they start talking in close-up; the friend answers steadily while the young man keeps glancing aside, and his look comes back harder on the third shot.

moments.action: The exchange continues in close-up until the camera pulls back to a two-shot: the young man has folded his arms and dropped his head while the friend stands facing him, still talking.

moments.action: The young man says something that lands badly; the friend's face screws up and he snaps back at him. The cut returns to the young man with his eyes lowered, taking it without reply.

moments.action: The friend keeps pressing, mouth twisting as his voice rises. The young man stares straight ahead, then lets his eyes fall shut; the last shot leaves the friend wide-eyed and pleading rather than angry.
